storyline.real: Prost wins from 13th on the grid: he passes Senna on lap 60, Senna's rear tyre fails three laps later, and Mansell passes Berger at the Peraltada for a Ferrari one-two
storyline.headline: Ferrari's day, and the polesitter left off the podium

eras.briefing: Mexico City, 1990. Prost started 13th in the Ferrari. Senna is gambling that his tyres will last without a stop. Pit board only: manage the tyres and the charge. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
